falseSynonyms.zh: 注意力不等於 awareness attention 是把注意力集中在某事；awareness 是知道或察覺某事存在。人可以知道某事但沒有持續專注。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Awareness means knowing something is there; attention means focusing on it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 興趣不等於意識 interest 表示想了解或覺得有趣；awareness 不要求有興趣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person may be aware of an issue without being interested in it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 記憶不等於 awareness memory 是保存／回想過去資訊；awareness 是對當下或某事實的知悉。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Memory concerns what is remembered; awareness concerns what is known or noticed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 意見不等於 awareness opinion 是對某事的看法或判斷；awareness 只表示知道、察覺或理解。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Awareness of a policy does not tell us whether someone supports it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 關注／憂慮不等於 awareness concern 可以表示擔心或重視；awareness 可以完全中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People can be aware of a risk without being especially concerned about it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經驗不等於 awareness experience 是親身經歷或累積經驗；它可增加 awareness，但不是 awareness 本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Experience can build awareness, but the two are not the same.

falseSynonyms.zh: 智力不等於 awareness intelligence 是推理和學習能力；awareness 是知悉、察覺或理解某事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON High intelligence does not guarantee awareness of a particular issue.

falseSynonyms.zh: 警報／警示不等於 awareness alert 可以是提醒訊息，或形容人警覺；awareness 是認知狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An alert may create awareness, but it is not the awareness itself.
